basis: Hereditary motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting and vocal cord paralysis reflect denervation without direct muscle or airway disease.

decisions.pulmonary: none: vocal cord paralysis results from motor nerve degeneration; direct inflammatory, structural or infiltrative airway injury is not established.

basis: Immune-mediated necrotizing GN with small-vessel vasculitis in 80-99%; pulmonary hemorrhage is <30%; broad skin and respiratory annotations do not establish common direct injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: necrotizing small-vessel vasculitis is intrinsic to the disease, including renal-limited vasculitis, and is annotated in 80-99%.

basis: SP7-related osteoporosis, fractures and skeletal deformities; delayed tooth eruption in 1/1 does not establish lasting dental damage; cardiovascular anomalies are 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: delayed tooth eruption in 1/1 patient does not establish direct dental injury or lasting loss of function; craniofacial bone abnormalities are musculoskeletal.

basis: Motor neuron degeneration defines ALS8; proximal amyotrophy in 10/16 reflects secondary denervation. Bulbar dysphagia does not establish gastrointestinal tissue disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: proximal amyotrophy occurs in 10/16, but follows motor neuron loss; direct skeletal muscle disease is not established.

basis: Neurodevelopmental disorder with hypogammaglobulinemia; cardiac defects and hearing impairment each 80-99%. Cap excludes common cleft palate, skin and skeletal abnormalities.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: hypogammaglobulinemia in 80-99% supports intrinsic immunodeficiency; the rules place applicable immune mechanisms in primary.

basis: Immune-complex small-vessel vasculitis with defining cutaneous vasculitic purpura. Renal and nerve injury are not established at >=30% specifically for type III.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: defining purpura represents cutaneous small-vessel inflammation and injury, rather than an incidental transient rash.

basis: Congenital cranial dysinnervation causes restricted ocular movement and ptosis; affected extraocular muscles belong to the ocular apparatus.

decisions.neurologic: primary: CFEOM5 is a congenital cranial dysinnervation disorder; abnormal motor innervation is intrinsic to the ocular motility disease.

basis: Vascular bleeding disorder; no blood-cell or coagulation defect is established. Gastrointestinal bleeding in 2/4 identifies a bleeding site without establishing intrinsic gastrointestinal injury.

decisions.haematologic: none: supplied evidence establishes vascular pathology but no disease of blood cells, marrow or coagulation; bleeding alone does not establish this axis.

basis: Inherited surfactant metabolism defect causes alveolar phospholipid accumulation in 5/5 and respiratory failure; pulmonary hypertension is a separately diagnosed secondary complication.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: congenital SP-B deficiency is an inherited disorder of surfactant metabolism, with abnormal alveolar phospholipid accumulation in 5/5 patients.

basis: Maternal ABO alloantibodies cause neonatal red-cell hemolysis and secondary unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia; jaundice does not establish liver injury.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: bilirubin elevation results from alloimmune red-cell destruction; an intrinsic bilirubin metabolism disorder is not established despite the broad ancestor.
